title: I Won A Rabbit At The Fair (Part 2) #shorts #horror
description: A CreepyCartoonTales story from Creepyville. What would you do? Tell us in the comments.
lines: Last time, your fair rabbit did your homework. Then it grew. And asked for carrots.
You buy every carrot in the supermarket. The cashier doesn't ask questions.
Marshmallow eats them all and shrinks back to tiny. Phew.
For a week, life is perfect. Perfect grades. A rabbit who folds your laundry.
Then you see the fair is back in town.
The same stall. The same man. The same smile.
But this time, the prizes aren't rabbits.
They're kids. Sitting in little cages. Doing homework.
"Don't worry," the man says. "They're very well fed."
You run home and grab Marshmallow.
"Did you come from there? Were you a kid?"
"No," it says. "I'm the one who won."
"Every year, a rabbit wins a child at the fair," it says calmly.
Then it hands you a carrot. "Eat it. Only carrots."
Tell me in the comments, and follow for more stories from Creepyville.
